# WÜSTHOF

> > WÜSTHOF is the official online store for hand-crafted German kitchen knives, offering precision-forged cutlery for every culinary application.

WÜSTHOF specializes in premium kitchen knives manufactured in Solingen, Germany, with collections ranging from classic chef's knives to specialized task knives. The site features a comprehensive product catalog, custom knife block builder tool, and curated collections organized by knife type and use case.

- [Asian-Style Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/asian-style-knives): WÜSTHOF Asian-style knives including Santoku and Nakiri styles
- [Utility Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/utility-knives): WÜSTHOF utility knife collection for peeling, trimming and slicing
- [Paring Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/paring-knives): WÜSTHOF paring knife collection for detailed kitchen tasks
- [Bread Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/bread-knives): WÜSTHOF serrated bread knives for slicing hand-crafted perfection
- [Carving Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/carving-knives): WÜSTHOF precision-forged carving and slicing knife collection
- [Cleavers & Butcher's Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/cleavers-butchers-knives): WÜSTHOF cleavers, butcher's and boning knife collection
- [Fish & Fillet Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/fish-fillet-knives): WÜSTHOF flexible fillet knives for fish and seafood preparation
- [Task Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/task-knives): WÜSTHOF specialty task knives including bread and steak knife sets
- [Seasonal Knives](https://wusthof.com/collections/seasonal-knives): WÜSTHOF specialty seasonal knives for tomato, cheese and peeling
